caption: A divided hot pot with spicy red oil broth on one side and clear broth on the other heats over a burner, and the red side comes to the boil while the clear side stays calm.

sa.check: A divided hot pot sits over a burner, with red oil broth on one side and clear broth on the other.
The red side comes to the boil: bubbles rise and burst through it.
The clear side stays nearly flat.
The divider keeps the two broths apart.
Each broth keeps to its own colour.

pc.expect: The red side's boil keeps up while the burner is under it and the clear side stays calmer throughout; the difference does not reverse.
pc.fail: The red side falls quiet and stays flat while the clear side churns; or the clear side boils harder than the red side; or the red side's boil stops and then starts again by itself; or the two sides swap which one is boiling.

pc.expect: The red side is a liquid with an oil layer on top through which large bubbles rise and burst; the clear side is a liquid showing at most small bubbles and faint steam.
pc.fail: The red layer holds a fixed shape while bubbles burst through it; or the oil layer stands in a heap above the broth; or the clear broth sets solid; or the red broth moves as one solid mass.

pc.expect: Each broth keeps to its own side and its own colour: red on one side and clear on the other.
pc.fail: Red broth appears on the clear side with none crossing the divider; or the clear broth turns red all over; or the two broths swap sides; or the red broth's colour drains away and leaves it clear.

pc.expect: The bubbles rise through each broth to its surface and any steam rises above the pot.
pc.fail: Bubbles sink from a surface toward the pot's floor; or hang still in the broth; or the steam sinks and pools around the burner; or broth climbs the divider and stays above it.

pc.expect: One pot with one divider and two broths; the broths stay on their own sides and nothing passes through the divider or the pot.
pc.fail: Broth passes through the divider; or the divider vanishes; or a third compartment appears; or broth passes through the pot's wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pot's rim, the burner and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes shape; or the burner moves by itself; or items on the table rearrange.
